messages:
jtucker: quick heads-up: saw a perf regression on canary for mqa-3b with paged-kv. p50 tokens up ~11% around seqlen 2k compared to last stable deploy.
anya: ack. which kernel path is firing? do we have profiler dumps?
jtucker: profiler snippet below (trimmed):

``
kernel_selector: picked fallback_attn_generic
reason: kv_page_stride 128 != tuned_stride 64
kv_prefetch: extra memcpy stalls ~1.6ms/step
matmul: using generic_tiled (no mqa optimizations)
```

kevin: that lines up with my hunch. we changed page packing to reduce fragmentation last week; autotuner probably never saw that layout variant.
samir: bench-bot shows the regression start ~1824840000 and matches bench results.
bench-bot: @samir benchmark registered -> id=bench/2026-05-07-0821, model=mqa-3b-paged, seqlen=2048, batch=4, device=rtx-a40
bench-bot: results -> p50=24.6ms (baseline 21.9ms), p95=48.2ms (baseline 45.3ms)
anya: quick mitigation ideas: (1) force kernel selector hint for mqa_paged_attn when seqlen>1024; (2) sweep kv_page_stride=64/128 and prefetch depth=0/1/2 to confirm.
jtucker: ran a local sweep. config and results: 

``
# hint + kv layout changes
selector.hint = "prefer_mqa_paged_v2"
kv.layout.page_stride = 64
kv.prefetch.depth = 1

# outcome
p50 @ seqlen=2048, batch=4 -> 21.7ms (matches baseline)
page_stride=128 -> ~+11% p50
```

kevin: clear signal: autotuner needs to include kv.layout features in its input vector. currently it only keys on model_arch, dtype, seq_stats, hw_profile.
anya: agree. also we should add a short-term canary override rather than a permanent force.
samir: proposed plan: 1) canary-deploy PR that enables a --kernel-force-pref flag for 1h; 2) retrain autotuner including kv.layout.*; 3) add CI microbench for seqlen buckets to prevent regressions.
jtucker: created PR with minimal changes: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/7342. touches runtime/kernel_selector.cc and autotune/trainer.py. exposes override flag.
kevin: also add a console alert: if post-deploy p50 delta >7% for any seqlen bucket, fire rollback pipeline. small CI microbench too (512/1024/2048).
bench-bot: launching matrix sweep: page_stride=[64,128], prefetch=[0,1,2], seqlen=[512,1024,2048], batch=[1,4]. partial uploads -> s3://bench-results/mqa-prefetch-sweep/1825129999/
anya: I'll own canary and the rollback condition. starting canary now for 1 hour with override flag set to prefer_mqa_paged_v2.
jtucker: thanks. if we still see bump on canary I'll attach full perf traces. if canary looks good we schedule longer autotuner retrain and fold kv.layout into feature schema.
kevin: created tiny tickets for follow-ups and assigned owners. let's keep the override short-lived.
anya: noted. will report back in ~45m with canary metrics. :thumbsup:
